pages.title: E8 Lattice
pages.text: Two hundred and forty roots, each touching the same number of neighbours, packed so tightly in eight dimensions that no sphere could be added anywhere. Viazovska proved it optimal in 2016.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Octonions and the Hopf fibration kept pointing at the same structure, so I fed both into the Tesseract Assembler with a G2 manifold and a little exotic matter. The lattice that came out was the one every symmetry I had studied was secretly a shadow of.
Made in $(item)Tesseract Assembler$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Transfinite Hierarchy.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Notes II, Theory of Everything.
